detail.longDescription: So far, migrated 4 Docker hosts from Portainer to Arcane, 3 more to go. Works like a charm, no issues at all so far. Would like to see a bit better display of elements on a vertical monitor and more “minimal” view but that’s just cosmetics with no operational issues after all. # OIDC # Arcane # Synology # Portainer # Docker # selfhosting # selfhosted # homelab
